author: IGN
description:
Remote listening station. 1984. An impossible signal appears. You’re the only one who can decode it. Get a peek at gameplay from Signal Station in this trailer for the upcoming tactile sci-fi thriller game. Signal Station will be available on PC in 2026.

In Signal Station,  you are the operator of a remote listening station who intercepts the first confirmed alien signal. Using authentic 1980s analog equipment, you must decode the message while managing survival, sabotage, and competing factions who all want to control what humanity hears. The game subverts traditional alien invasion tropes, focusing on the mounting psychological pressure and the realization that the real danger isn't from space - it's human.
title: Signal Station - Official Gameplay Teaser Trailer

description:

Occult skills and a poker-esque deck let you customize your build and blast through the black-magic-fueled foes of The Order and The Damned as you aim to be the last one standing. author: IGN
description:
Get another look at gameplay and more from Atre: Dominance Wars in this latest trailer for the upcoming 4X RTS/RPG that takes inspiration from Heroes of Might and Magic, Age of Wonders, and Stellaris from developer Ironward (developer behind The Red Solstice series). Become an Elder, a master Sorcerer. Manipulate or conquer your way to godhood, mastering arcane spells and transforming your armies in this lore-rich 4X real-time/turn-based strategy game. Achieve total domination—or destroy the world itself. Atre: Dominance Wars will be available on PC, and a demo is out on Steam on February 9, 2026. You can learn more about Atre: Dominance Wars and wishlist here if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2805850/Atre_Dominance_Wars/

author: IGN
description:
If you like this video and would like to see more like it, make sure to subscribe to Eurogamer on YouTube. 

Grand Theft Auto 6, when it eventually arrives, is going to be one of the biggest entertainment launches in human history. And despite having been a massive fan of the series since all the way back in 1997, I'm dreading it. When GTA 6 got delayed to November, it felt like a godsend for everyone not planning to release anything in November. But that was a mere reprieve. Whenever it hits, it's going to cause endless discussion and debate about all the usual stuff: violence in video games, too woke, not progressive enough, best game ever, it's bad actually, reams and reams of all you can eat discourse. You can no doubt already see the thumbnails in your mind's eye. There was a very silly rumour recently that publisher 2K might cancel GTA 6 altogether... and it's hard not to wonder if that would ultimately be for the best.

GTA 6 cancelled? GTA 6 delayed again? Will GTA 6 ever come
title: I Hope GTA 6 Never Comes Out... Hear Me Out!

author: IGN
description: Ryan Phillippe stars as a former special forces operative trying to reconnect with his teenage daughter during a college road trip. When an unexpected detour puts them in the sights of a secretive, off-the-grid community, his daughter is taken and the trip erupts into a high-octane fight for survival. Alone and outnumbered, he’s forced to use every skill he has to track them down, take them apart, and bring his daughter home.
title: One Mile - Official Trailer (2026) Ryan Phillippe, Amélie Hoeferle

author: IGN
description:
Island of Ash is a third-person action-adventure with RPG elements. Explore handcrafted locations, fight without stamina limits, develop your character through stats, magic, and alchemy, and uncover the secrets of a lost civilization.
Head over to Steam and add Island of Ash to your Wishlist.
title: Island of Ash - Official Announcement Trailer

author: IGN
description: Check out the Playtest Trailer for VOID PRIEST, a lovecraftian psychological horror detective game told through rituals, relics, and madness. You are the Void Priest, bound to an elder god against your will. You are not only a servant. You are an investigator. To survive, you must read the world and people like a puzzle and uncover what others cannot. VOID PRIEST is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a Playtest available now on Steam.
title: VOID PRIEST - Official Playtest Launch Trailer

author: IGN
description: Get a deep dive into the weapons you'll use to fight against your enemies in this latest Crisol: Theater of Idols video for the upcoming horror first-person shooter game. Blumhouse Games Creative Lead Louise Blain discusses how your blood is your ammunition, prompting you to consider whether to carefully choose your battles or sacrifice your health to take down enemies. We also get a breakdown of weapon designs and much more. Crisol: Theater of Idols will be available on PC (Steam), PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S on February 10, 2026.
title: Crisol: Theater of Idols - Official 'Setting the Stage Episode 3: Weapons' Trailer
